title: Uncertain
paragraphs: “Ugh… ugh…”
Father had turned pale beyond his limit. Older Sister was speechless and collapsed to the ground.

“After the slave crest’s master registration was canceled, I took care of retrieving the body. According to Melromarc’s slave trade laws, I buried it in the slave cemetery prepared in the nearby forest.”
“I-It’s just that it’s what it ‘seems’ like. So, Sadeena, stay strong! Let’s… just go check it out, just to be sure!”
“Yes… you’re right.”
Father tried to console Older Sister, but she looked like she was trembling slightly.
“However…”
The monster merchant was wiping his sweat, looking apologetic. What’s wrong now? Father furrowed his brows and shifted his gaze to the monster merchant.
“When the Four Holy Heroes resolved the great incident in Melromarc, countless bodies from the cemetery were turned into undead, so verifying the body may be difficult. Yes.”
This time, Father seemed to reach his limit. He staggered back, and then walked unsteadily toward me, gripping my shoulder. Even I can read the atmosphere sometimes.
“Yeah… I know loops can have developments like this… but this is tough. That girl, Raphtalia… I bet she was really brave. Maybe that’s why Motoyasu mistook her.”
“Yes, indeed. The older sister was very courageous and was a reliable partner to Father.”

I still remember. When Takt had us cornered, the older sister risked her life to help everyone, including me, escape. Back then, the old lady protected her and helped her get away. I also remember how Filo-tan was badly injured. That old lady was brave too. If I recall, she was the older sister’s mentor.
I never imagined the older sister would meet such an end. No, we haven’t confirmed that it was her yet.
“Father, you don’t have to say it. I understand. Like Itsuki, if there’s another loop, I will definitely save the older sister.”
“I’m counting on you! I’ll never let something like this happen again!”

I understand. The older sister is also Filo-tan’s older sister. Unlike Stalker Pig, she’s someone who should be prioritized. I burned that thought into my brain, adding as many “absolutely” as possible.
“Then, I must remember where the older sister was. Would it be best if Father bought her here?”
“No… I want you to save her as soon as possible! Even if this information turns out to be wrong.”

Yes, that’s true. Even if this information is wrong, we can still plan to retrieve her when she arrives here. If I come here regularly, I might be able to find her. The more options we have, the better.

Besides, since there’s no body, there’s no guarantee that it’s really her. We must not lose hope. Father kept encouraging Older Sister to stay strong. She said she was fine, but she looked a little exhausted.
“If only we could track the slave crest… but if the body is gone, that’s impossible, right?”
“Depending on the soil and other factors, undead can sometimes form, but I never expected it to happen in that cemetery. Yes.”

Searching for bodies that turned into undead from scratch would take an incredible amount of time. On top of that, with the severe damage they’ve sustained, would it even be possible to identify them?

It’s already been two months since then. The bodies of the zombies were gathered in one place and disposed of as part of Melromarc’s reconstruction efforts, so they would be badly decayed by now. It’s impossible to find her.
“Then please tell me the list of owners of the slave who is believed to be the older sister, in chronological order.”
“Here are the results of our investigation. Yes.”
I looked through the documents handed over by the monster merchant. It seems that about a week before I was summoned, she was with a certain noble. That includes the time for transportation.

After that, she was with this monster merchant for about a week, then went to her next master, where her condition rapidly deteriorated, and she died… it seems. Incidentally, that noble was a victim of the vengeful spirit of the Crimson Swine and is already dead. If he weren’t, I would have gone to kill him.
“Then I’ll get the portal ready for that location so we can save her as quickly as possible.”
“Please… even if it turns out to be wrong, please, find that girl no matter what.”
“Understood!”

I engraved Father’s request deeply into my memory. The lack of confirmation that she’s dead is a sign of hope. Since I haven’t found Filo-tan either, I feel even closer to Father and the others now. Around that time, Itsuki and Ren used the portal to come see us at Melromarc’s castle. Father explained the situation to them.
“Um… Naofumi-san, please stay strong.”

Hearing the story about the older sister, who was missing and presumed dead, Itsuki tried to comfort Father. It seems that Itsuki and Ren had been taking care of Fohl. They also used a powerful potion, Yggdrasil Medicine, to heal Fohl’s sister and restore her strength.
“I’m still holding up, but Sadeena must be really worried… We’ve had a lot of death reports about the children from the village too…”

To my eyes, Older Sister seems to be her usual self. But according to Father, she’s extremely worn out. Well, through the tracking investigation, we’ve managed to rescue a few of the village’s slaves. However, it seems that many died due to the incident caused by the vengeful spirit of the Crimson Swine.
“I see…”
“Still… it’s tough. You know, Motoyasu-kun said she was my reliable partner. Just thinking that such a girl might be dead is…”
“…Are you the Shield Hero?”
Fohl came over and offered his hand as a greeting. Hmm, he seems to have good manners. He’s a little different from the one in the first world.
“I will fight to repay you for saving Atla. I’ll be in your care from now on.”
Father lightly shook Fohl’s outstretched hand, but his expression was a bit complicated.
“Um… nice to meet you. If possible, I’d like you to follow Ren and Itsuki’s instructions.”
“Hm? Got it.”
Fohl tilted his head. It seems he sensed something was off.
“Alright, Atla, shall we go?”
“Yes, Brother.”

Oh, the little sister seems to be doing well too. She’s still being carried by Fohl, though. But she doesn’t look so weak that she needs to be carried. I think she could walk just fine. As I was thinking that, the Queen arrived.
“Ah, Amaki-sama, Kawasumi-sama… I’m sorry that this report brought such unfortunate news.”
“No, no, it’s not confirmed that Naofumi-san’s companion has passed away yet.”
“That’s right. Please use every information network available.”
“Understood. As queen, I will do everything I can to ensure that the demi-humans of the Seatto territory can return to their normal lives as soon as possible.”
At that point, the Queen turned her gaze to Fohl and his sister.
“Oh? Are these new companions?”
“Yes… They’re of the Hakuko race, which has a deep connection with Melromarc…”
“I felt a bit uneasy about it, but I thought it would be best to report directly to Naofumi and Motoyasu that they’ve successfully joined us.”
The Queen stared intently at Fohl and his sister. Is something wrong?
“This is… I see.”
“W-What is it?”
“Did you notice something? I don’t quite understand.”
“Come to think of it, Atla-san speaks a bit like Yuki-san, doesn’t she?”
Yuki-chan, who had been quiet, tilted her head at that. She wasn’t hiding, just quietly standing by my side.
“Do I?”
“Brother, do I really sound similar?”
Fohl shook his head.
“There’s no way she sounds the same. Atla is Atla.”
“Motoyasu-sama, do I resemble that person?”

Yuki-chan asked me. Not at all, I think. Honestly, if I recall correctly from the first world, that little sister was such a handful that even Father found her bothersome, and both Ren and Itsuki struggled with her. In the end, she turned out to be a remarkable person, but aside from that, she was practically a pig in my opinion. Back then, I seriously unleashed my skills on her a few times. Though she skillfully deflected them.
“I don’t think you’re similar at all.”
Yuki-chan has elegance and grace. Fohl’s sister is more like a wild child. From what I recall of the first world, she was quite hot-blooded, so there’s no way they’re alike.
